topic: Titles and example areas of study
outcome: Know the six titles and their example areas of study; example areas are neither compulsory nor exclusive

topic: Titles and example areas of study
outcome: Art, craft and design: practical and critical/contextual work using 2D and/or 3D processes and media from two or more titles

topic: Titles and example areas of study
outcome: Fine art: drawing, painting, mixed media, sculpture, ceramics, installation, printmaking, moving image and photography

topic: Titles and example areas of study
outcome: Graphic communication: interactive media, advertising, packaging, print, illustration, branding, motion graphics and film and television design

topic: Titles and example areas of study
outcome: Textile design: fashion, costume, digital and printed textiles, domestic textiles, interiors and installed textiles

topic: Titles and example areas of study
outcome: Three-dimensional design: ceramics, sculpture, exhibition, theatre and film design, product, environmental and architectural design, jewellery and 3D digital design

topic: Titles and example areas of study
outcome: Photography: portraiture, landscape, still life, documentary, fashion, experimental imagery, multimedia, installation and moving image
Experience a variety of traditional and new media, processes and techniques suited to the chosen areas, building knowledge through research, idea development and making
Take an active part in the course, recognising your strengths and sustaining your own lines of enquiry
Develop practical and theoretical knowledge of materials, processes, technologies and resources
Understand how ideas, feelings and meanings are conveyed and interpreted in images and artefacts
Understand how images and artefacts relate to the time, place and social and cultural contexts of their making
Understand continuity and change in genres, styles and traditions

Explore resources; analyse, discuss and evaluate images, objects and artefacts; make independent judgements

Show critical and contextual work through 2D and/or 3D processes and media in each component
